text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian state radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these headlines and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs has gone to the Portuguese town of Sintra to take part in NATO foreign ministers meeting to begin laying the groundwork for deciding which countries will be invited to join the alliance.
- President Guntis Ulmanis went to The Hague yesterday to take part in celebrations to mark the 50th anniversary of the Marshall Plan. He had a short conversation with President Bill Clinton.
- A World Bank mission is assessing the effectiveness of credits to the agriclutural sector.
- Latvian railways holds a meeting today to confirm its 1997 work plan. It said that cargo transported last year rose by 28 percent.
- Two Danish navy vessels are to pay a visit to Riga, visitors are welcome on board.
